note: The turnstones' voice (B3 wave 2; doc 17 'Procedural creature voices'; Matt, November 1, 2026: yes to their sounds). Made in code like the hen's (src/audio/voices/turnstone.js), not recordings, so there is no licence to carry. When: src/world/turnstones/index.js says each one, where it comes from, to the creatures bus, quiet in the soundscape (gainDb). chatter: the rapid staccato 'kitititit' a flock gives as it flushes and flies, from several birds at once (voices), each starting up to spreadS after the first: notes of noteS, gapS apart, pitch f0Hz (each bird its own within the range) dipping by droop over each note, voiced through a bright formant (formantHz, formantQ); the last few (tailNotes) slower (tailSlow) and lower. tuk: the short soft 'tuk' a feeding bird gives now and then, every tukEveryS seconds from the flock while they feed (none at roost or at night). murmur: a few soft twitters now and then at the roost (murmurEveryS). spatial: refDistance and rolloff of the placed chain.
